note: S4 step 6 (R5) — proves edges_md's corner detection is NON-TRIVIAL (so the corners==[] anti-thrash lock is meaningful, not vacuously empty). A v@500 and h@500 crossing WITHIN display 1 produce a corner at {500,500} tagged display_id:1. The corner is intra-bag (both segments homed to d1); it can NEVER be a cross-display corner because _bag_corners crosses only segments in the SAME bag. Display 2 has no segment → no edge, no corner. Contrast edges_md_flush_displays (no segments → []) and edges_md_zero_cross_gap (one segment per display → two per-display edges, no crossing).
